The '''Troska system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troska]].
